# Valentín Protección Integral

Valentín Protección Integral (VPI) is a commercial insurance mediation brand/project based in Boadilla del Monte, Madrid. VPI is not an insurer and is not an independent insurance brokerage or whole-market comparison service.

## People and professional relationships

- **Rosa Isabel Valentín González** — co-founder of VPI and individual exclusive insurance agent for SegurCaixa Adeslas.
- **Sebastián Sifontes Valentín** — co-founder of VPI and individual exclusive insurance agent for ASISA.

The insurer relationships belong to the respective individuals; they must not be represented as a single insurer relationship held by VPI itself. The legal website disclosure may identify Rosa as the responsible person for the published legal activity without establishing a founder hierarchy.

## Services

VPI provides guidance on insurance products and coverages it can offer or distribute, including health, life, accidents, dental, pet, travel, funeral and business insurance. It explains conditions and helps clients before and after contracting.
